name: Loan Approval Agent
description: This agent helps lenders evaluate loan applications by computing a credit score for the applicant and then deciding whether the loan should be approved based on the applicant's credit score, debt, income, and requested loan amount.

skills.name: Get_Credit_Score
skills.description: Calculates a credit score (300-850) for a loan applicant based on their SSN, outstanding debt, annual income, and applicant ID. Applies whenever the user wants to score an applicant, get a credit score, or assess creditworthiness.
examples: What is the credit score for applicantId APP-001, ssn 123-45-6789, income 150000, debt 12000?
Get the credit score for applicantId APP-002, ssn 999-12-3456, income 50000, debt 25000
Score applicantId APP-003 with ssn 555-44-3333, income 90000, debt 5000

skills.name: Approve_Loan
skills.description: Decides whether a loan application should be approved, given the applicant's credit score, debt, income, requested loan amount, and applicant ID. Returns an approve/reject decision with rationale. Applies whenever the user wants to approve a loan, decide on a loan application, or assess loan eligibility. Requires a credit score - if not provided, request one first via Get_Credit_Score.
examples: Approve a loan for applicantId APP-001, ssn 123-45-6789, income 150000, debt 12000, loanAmount 250000
Approve a loan for applicantId APP-001, ssn 123-45-6789, income 50000, debt 12000, loanAmount 250000
Approve a loan for APP-002 with creditScore 720, income 85000, debt 12000, loanAmount 100000
Decide on this loan: applicantId APP-003, ssn 555-44-3333, income 200000, debt 5000, loanAmount 500000
